headline: Dalvin Cook Will Anchor Put the Kittle On
summary: Put the Kittle On will have a great opportunity to prove the prognosticators wrong after being expected to finish seventh in WBA Fantasy Classic. They have five wide receivers to turn to, but they are unlikely to carry the team to victory. They're projected to average 184.26 points this season, less than the league average of 216.14. Not surprisingly, Put the Kittle On landed a foursome of wide receivers with plenty of room to grow.
